title: Spanish Paella Cooking Class in Chicago (Includes 3-Course Meal)
includes: All fresh ingredients and kitchen equipment provided.
Enjoy the 3-course Spanish menu you prepare.
Take-home recipes for tapas, paella and flan.
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Tapas, paella and flan – this hands-on Spanish cooking class in Chicago, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, takes you through three pillars of coastal Spanish cuisine in one vibrant, skill-building experience.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Gambas al Ajillo with shrimp, garlic, lemon, chile flakes and sourdough
- Seafood Paella with mussels, shrimp, saffron, bomba rice and chistorra
- Mango Flan with eggs, milk, condensed milk, evaporated milk and mango purée

You will leave with the skills to make authentic Spanish paella and tapas at home. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy throughout the experience.
